name: review
description: Walk the unified AI-request inbox; dispatch each Task to its specialist skill as a subagent.

name: create-footnote
description: Draft a footnote body, insert \footnote{} Atom at anchor, write FootnoteRef card.

name: create-citation
split_reason: External source search + bib entry creation
description: Search Crossref/OpenAlex/etc.; add to references.bib; create CitationRef card.

name: create-quotation
description: Assemble a QuotationGroup nesting references + quotes + anchor links.

name: create-card
split_reason: Same commandments; only body shape differs by kind
description: Create a new card of the specified kind at the given anchor.

name: create-revision-suggestion
split_reason: Carries 'Virgil as author' UI mark; behavioral fork
description: Propose a revision to a paragraph. Always emits with author='virgil'.

name: create-cut-suggestion
description: Propose a cut or rewrite of an existing excerpt in Cutter panel.

name: edit-card
description: Modify an existing card's body or fields.

name: archive-card
split_reason: Mobility affordance is uniform across ontology
description: Move a card to the archive panel.

name: restore-card
description: Restore a card from the archive to its prior panel.

name: move-card
description: Re-anchor a card to a different paragraph or atom.

name: link-cards
description: Create a relationship link between two cards.

name: answer-note-request
description: Answer a flagged note. Sibling note OR revision-suggestion if doc edit.

name: answer-todo-request
description: Classify flagged todo as text-edit, missing-artifact, analysis, or limit.

name: answer-cutter-comment
description: Respond to a flagged Cutter comment by drafting a CutterSuggestionCard.

name: answer-revision-comment
description: Respond to a flagged Revisions comment. Sibling OR suggestion if doc edit.

name: answer-bib-review
description: Three-mode: verify/fill fields, draft annotation, or swap library entry.

name: sync-bib-to-library
description: Reconcile paper bibliography against library: swap matched / triage missing / flag ambiguous.

name: style-merge
description: Merge user preamble customizations onto a target style. Rewrites .tex; body untouched.

name: research-paragraph
description: Walk the paragraph's anchored citations; check assertions vs cited sources.

name: find-source
description: Search library for papers supporting or contradicting a stated claim.

name: extract-quote
description: Pull quotable passages from a named library paper on a given topic.

name: summarize-source
description: Surface library annotation for a cited source or generate one from the text.

name: check-citation-fit
description: Per anchored citation: does the source support the claim it's anchored to?

name: related-from-library
description: Suggest related library papers not yet cited in the paragraph.

name: triangulate
description: For a claim, find library papers that agree, disagree, or qualify.

name: preflight
description: Non-destructive scan of an external .tex file. Reports constructs needing conversion.

name: prep-file
description: Umbrella: runs preflight + dispatches converters. Produces Virgil-compatible folder.

name: convert-examples
description: Convert gb4e/linguex/\enumsentence to expex. Shared with library di-examples.

name: expand-macros
description: Inline-expand unsafe \newcommand definitions; preserve safe ones.

name: migrate-preamble
description: Move externally-authored preamble onto a Virgil style.

name: migrate-bib
description: Handle natbib ↔ biblatex / \bibliography{} ↔ \printbibliography / bibstyle swaps.

name: quarantine-tikz
description: Move inline TikZ/pgfplots to external files via \input{}.

name: revise-dictation
description: Fix dictation errors, complete sentence boundaries, resolve homophones.

name: revise-typos
description: Typos + punctuation + capitalization only.

name: revise-incomplete
description: Find unfinished sentences; complete or flag.

name: revise-cut-hedges
split_reason: Distinct preservation rule: epistemic-load hedges stay
description: Remove 'perhaps,' 'arguably,' etc. unless doing real epistemic work.

name: revise-cut-throat-clearing
description: Strip 'Importantly,' 'In this paper I will argue,' etc.

name: revise-cut-redundancy
description: Same point made twice → kept once.

name: revise-compress
description: Compress to target word count or %.

name: revise-cut-filler
description: Adverbs that don't earn it ('very'/'really'/'actually').

name: revise-flow
description: Reorder sentences/paragraphs for argument flow. Sentence content unchanged.

name: revise-paragraphs
description: Split overlong; merge fragmented. Sentence content unchanged.

name: revise-transitions
description: Add/strengthen transitions only.

name: revise-topic-sentences
description: Extract or compose topic sentences.

name: revise-make-explicit
description: Flag and make explicit unstated premises, jumps, assumptions.

name: revise-clarify-claims
description: Find vague claims; tighten or flag for citation.

name: revise-disambiguate
description: Find pronouns + references that risk reader confusion.

name: revise-strengthen-weak-points
description: Find load-bearing argument moves; surface where under-supported.

name: revise-voice-match
description: Match surrounding text's voice.

name: revise-register
description: Formal ↔ conversational on user request.

name: revise-de-AI
description: Remove AI tells if external/Virgil AI content slipped in.

name: revise-from-notes
description: Notes → prose; more aggressive than revise-dictation.

name: revise-expand
description: Thin paragraph → full. User flags direction.

name: revise-add-example
description: Find abstract claims; propose concrete examples.

name: revise-add-counter
description: Propose a counter-consideration the argument should address.

name: revise-free
description: Any intervention as needed. First move: propose what it would do, ask for confirmation.

name: revise-to-thesis
description: Extract a one-sentence thesis.

name: revise-to-bullets
description: Prose → bullets for outline/reorg.

name: revise-to-summary
description: Target word count summary.

name: revise-compare
description: Propose 2-3 alternative revisions side-by-side.

name: revise-explain
description: For an existing revision, articulate why each change was made.

name: revise-with-feedback
description: User rejects with reason; feedback feeds user-dream rejection corpus.

name: iterate-virgil-editor
description: Stress-test editor skill set in sandboxed sample paper.

name: dream
description: Overnight autonomous pass. Reads DEV-mode memos; refactors/edits skills, scripts, manifest.
